address: 4/5 Barrierra Wharf, Liesse Hill, Valletta, VLT 1941, Malta
bio: Housed in an 18C building near Gozo ferry terminal, this restaurant ranks among the island’s most atmospheric for many reasons. The indoor dining room occupies a historic former icehouse, while the alfresco terrace offers a breathtaking view of the Grand Harbour. The kitchen rises to the setting with a distinct Mediterranean spirit, expressed through modern and imaginative dishes. Each course is tied to a street in the city centre, and a small tile bearing its name, along with a brief historical anecdote, is brought to the table as the dish is served....
